Shai-Hulud hits npm and PyPI

Campaign: shai-hulud-here-we-go-again
Date: 2026-05-11 to 2026-05-12 (1 day)
Actor: TeamPCP (group)
Impact: credential_theft, self_propagation
User Impact: 200000000

Synopsis

Shai-Hulud: Here We Go Again was a May 2026 TeamPCP campaign affecting roughly 169 to 170+ npm package names, plus 2 PyPI packages, with combined reported download volume above 200 million per week. It groups broad npm activity and guardrails-ai beyond separately tracked TanStack, OpenSearch, and mistralai records. The npm payload used Bun, lifecycle hooks, OIDC/trusted-publishing abuse, cloud, Kubernetes, Vault, local secret harvesting, GitHub and Session/Oxen exfiltration, npm self-propagation, and token-revocation sabotage.
